headline: Jordan's economy grows 3% in Q2 2026 despite war conditions and their repercussions
summary: Jordan's Department of Statistics reported real GDP growth of 3% in the second quarter of 2026, up from 2.8% a year earlier. The growth rate is the highest in years despite war repercussions in the region.
why: Jordan is a small open economy highly exposed to regional conflict, trade routes and remittances, so its growth data signals regional stability for investors.
